description: CCC vs CDR (d = 1, boost 1, 100 s) for the four stable-trained policies per family, 64 paired trials each (evaluation seeds 5000-5063), changing world; the same trials as eval_phases.py. Per trial: time of the first harvest from either new patch (None if none by 700 s), h at the start of the recanalization phase, and h at the end of the trial. Summary per family and arm, pooled over trials: fraction that never harvested from the new patches, median first-harvest time among those that did, and fraction ending at h <= -100.
